{{Short description|Finnish molecular geneticist}}
'''Tuula Teeri''' (born 1957) is a Finnish [[molecular genetics|molecular geneticist]] and the President of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Engineering Sciences]] (IVA).<ref>{{Cite web|title=Tuula Teeri, new President of IVA|url=http://www.iva.se/en/published/we-welcome-tuula-teeri-new-president-of-iva/|access-date=2021-10-05|website=www.iva.se|language=en}}</ref>  She has previously been a Vice President at the [[Royal Institute of Technology]] (KTH) in Stockholm and President of [[Aalto University]] from April 1, 2009 to 2017.<ref>{{cite web|date=2008-12-19|title=Professor Tuula Teeri as President of Aalto University|url=http://www.tkk.fi/en/current_affairs/news/view/professori_tuula_teeri_aalto-yliopiston_rehtoriksi/|url-status=dead|archive-url=https://archive.today/20120918144740/http://www.tkk.fi/en/current_affairs/news/view/professori_tuula_teeri_aalto-yliopiston_rehtoriksi/|archive-date=2012-09-18|access-date=2010-02-06|publisher=Helsinki University of Technology}}</ref> Professor Teeri started as the President of IVA on November 1, 2017

She holds a Ph.D. from the University of Helsinki (1987) and was elected a member of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] in 2004.<ref name="KVA 041014">[http://www.kva.se/sv/Nyheter/2008/Nya-ledamoter-i-tekniska-klassen/ Kungl. Vetenskapsakademien: Nya ledamöter i tekniska klassen], press announcement 2004-10-14 {{in lang|sv}}{{Dead url|date=January 2024}}</ref>
